article.headline: Jones has 29, CSU Bakersfield beats Hawaii 76-64
article.description: — Jemel Jones scored 29 points as CSU Bakersfield beat Hawaii 76-64 on Thursday.
article.linkText: Jones has 29, CSU Bakersfield beats Hawaii 76-64

categories.description: Hawai'i Rainbow Warriors @ Cal State Bakersfield Roadrunners

event.description: Hawai'i Rainbow Warriors @ Cal State Bakersfield Roadrunners

keywords: Hawai'i Rainbow Warriors @ Cal State Bakersfield Roadrunners
article.story: BAKERSFIELD, Calif. -- — Jemel Jones scored 29 points as CSU Bakersfield beat Hawaii 76-64 on Thursday. Jones also contributed five rebounds for the Roadrunners (14-18, 8-12 Big West Conference). CJ Hardy scored 19 points and added six rebounds. Marvin McGhee shot 6 for 15, including 4 for 9 from beyond the arc to finish with 16 points. The Rainbow Warriors (15-15, 7-12) were led in scoring by Gytis Nemeiksa, who finished with 21 points. Tanner Christensen added 12 points and seven rebounds for Hawaii. Tom Beattie finished with 11 points. Hawaii visits CSU Northridge in its next matchup on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
